title: 第33章 情愫初动第34章 生死一许
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
那女孩静静看着副手足无措的赵宇，内心异样连连，又看了看身上多处被赵宇包扎好的伤口，不觉脸上一阵娇羞，脸蛋发烫，又看赵宇如此清澈纯真的眼神，也不觉呆了，赵宇见那女孩盯着他，更显不好意思，讷讷无言，一脸尴尬。
女孩内心想笑，也不好意思，就说道：“此次承蒙少侠相救，不胜感激，我叫南宫秋月，不知少侠高姓大名，可否告知？”
赵宇这十多年来，接触多些就是大伯和安伯，但也交流甚少，好在前段时和几个器灵在一起说说笑笑，但那几个器灵毕竟不是有真实血肉的人类，而今天真正和一个女孩在一起还真是平生第一次，又年纪尚小，难免紧张。
赵宇见女孩开口问他，依旧有口不对题，讪讪说道：“那姑娘不用问我，我，我……”
话到此竟卡住了。
啊！
少侠是我唐突了，我不该这样问的，你别放在心上。”
赵宇一听浑身冒汗，知道自己前言不搭后语，把女孩搞误会了，就更紧张了：“姑，姑娘，我不是这个意思，救你不过是随便的，你不用放在心上的，我叫赵宇，不是少侠。”
说完他突然转过身去，从灵戒中拿出一壶水，又有几颗补气血的丹药，递给了南宫秋月：“姑娘你把这几颗丹药吃了，是补气血的，别怕。”
看着语无伦次的赵宇，南宫秋月真欲笑不能，心想这世上怎么有这么单纯的人呢？是傻吗？不对！
不是说目光清澈之人不可能是傻的，可能对方见了女孩子就坚张吧。
她想接过药丸和水，稍一动浑身一阵剧痛，双手无力垂了下去，只好轻轻言道：“我还动不了，等会吧。”
赵宇一看若等那女孩伤势好转回来，那可不是一时半会，只能硬着头皮说道：“那我喂你吧，可，可以吗？”
南宫秋月点点头：“好，你先扶我一下，让我坐起来好些。”
赵宇靠近一步，弯下腰来，准备把南宫秋月扶起半个身子靠在树上，伸手碰到南宫秋月身上时，又停下来不好意思动了。
南宫秋月毕竟是大家闺秀，见多识广，态度大方多了，她知道赵宇不好意思，便道：“你刚才都帮我包扎身子了，扶我一下还用不好意思？”
赵宇有些尴尬，嘿嘿一笑，这才伸手把南宫秋月扶了起来半靠在树上，又拿起药丸送到南宫秋月嘴边，南宫秋月含住药丸，又喝了一口赵宇递上的水，把药丸吞了下去，开始炼化。
大约过了一个时辰，南宫秋月把药丸炼化，顿时感觉到身体好了不少，睁眼一看，赵宇一步不移在她身前，手中紧握着一把短刀，紧张盯着四周，怕有不测，一直在为他护法。
南宫秋月猛然间心中颤动，一种无法言明的感觉涌向全身，两眼湿润。
停顿了一会，她对赵宇轻唤道：“赵，赵宇，你给我的药我炼化好了，那丹药效果真很好，我现在感觉好多了，谢谢你！”

“赵宇”
这是她一生第一次喊出的两个字。
赵宇闻声回头一看南宫秋月，果然神色好了许多，长长舒了一口气，一脸激动。
南宫秋月又对赵宇说道：“你看我两手还不便，你可以给我拢一拢头发扎一下吗？”
赵宇一看果然如此，南宫秋月披头散发，甚是狼狈。
虽仍感到有些不好意思，还是走了过去，把南宫秋月的头发理了理，手忙脚乱把头发扎了扎，扎得实在无款无式。
他又看到南宫秋月脸上污渍血迹，有些吓人，拿出一块布条沾上水，给南宫秋月擦了擦脸，待他把南宫秋月脸上的污渍血迹擦净以后，赵宇整个人都惊呆了！
他出生至今虽没见过什么女人，但下意识中他知道，世上没几个有如此美丽的容颜。
南宫秋月看着一脸发呆的赵宇，自己也有些紧张，不解问道：“怎么啦？我脸上长花了，还是破相了？”
听到南宫秋月的声音，赵宇从发呆的状态回过神来，心中一阵不安，感到自己太丢脸、太失礼了，满脸热烫不好意思地回答道：“你的脸没被破相，很好很好的，我是看着南宫小姐太美了，所以……”
赵宇低下头不知说什么好了。
好像世间所有的女子都喜欢被人称赞自己的美貌，南宫秋月这点也不能免俗，特别是赵宇那纯正的语态，真实的告白，更使她内心一阵激荡，本来优雅大方的她也变得扭捏起来，一脸娇羞：“哪有啊，我长得一般般啦，赵公子是不是经常这样夸别的女孩子？”
“啊！”
赵宇闻此言，一声惊呼，声音低沉有些不自然地说道：“说真的除了我娘，你是我第一个真正见过又一起说话的女孩！
我娘也只是小时候见过，现在她的样子我已记不得了。”
“怎么可能？”
这次轮到南宫秋月大吃一惊，又重复一句：“这怎么可能？”
愣了愣又道：“那你娘呢？”
听到南宫秋的问话，赵宇就像被人按了停止键，声音动作整个人寂静不动，只是呆呆地看着远方。
南宫秋月突然一阵心痛，一种很深很重的那种心痛，心中已有猜想，在赵宇身上一定发生非同寻常的事情。

content_en:
The girl looked at the helpless Zhao Yu quietly, feeling strange in her heart. Then she looked at the many wounds on her body that had been bandaged by Zhao Yu. Her face felt shy and hot, and when she looked at Zhao Yu's clear and innocent eyes, she felt dumb. When Zhao Yu saw the girl staring at him, he looked even more embarrassed, speechless and embarrassed.
The girl wanted to laugh in her heart, but was embarrassed, so she said: "Thank you very much for saving me this time, young hero. My name is Nangong Qiuyue. I don't know what the young hero's name is. Can you tell me?"
In the past ten years or so, Zhao Yu has had more contact with his uncle and Amber, but he has had little communication. Fortunately, he chatted and laughed with a few artifact spirits some time ago, but those artifact spirits are not human beings with real flesh and blood. Today, it is really the first time in his life to be with a girl, and he is still young, so he is inevitably nervous.
When Zhao Yu saw the girl asking him, she still didn't know what she was talking about, and said sarcastically: "The girl doesn't need to ask me, I, I..."
The words got stuck at this point.
ah!
Young hero, I was rude, I shouldn't have asked this, don't take it to heart. "
When Zhao Yu heard this, he was sweating all over. He knew that what he said was inconsistent with what he said and had misunderstood the girl. He became even more nervous: "Girl, girl, I didn't mean it like this. Saving you is just casual. You don't need to take it to heart. My name is Zhao Yu, not a young hero. "
After saying that, he suddenly turned around, took out a pot of water from the spiritual ring, and a few pills to replenish qi and blood, and handed them to Nangong Qiuyue: "Girl, take these pills to replenish qi and blood, don't be afraid. "
Looking at Zhao Yu who was talking incoherently, Nangong Qiuyue really wanted to laugh, thinking how could there be such a simple person in this world? Is it stupid? No!
It doesn't mean that a person with clear eyes cannot be stupid. Maybe the other person becomes assertive when he sees a girl.
She wanted to take the pills and water, but when she moved a little, she felt a sharp pain all over her body. Her hands fell down weakly, so she could only say softly: "I can't move yet, let's wait a while." "
Zhao Yu saw that if he waited for the girl to recover from her injuries, it would not be a while, so he could only bite the bullet and said: "Then I will feed you, but, is that okay? "
Nangong Qiuyue nodded: "Okay, help me first so that I can sit up better. "
Zhao Yu took a step closer, bent down, and was about to lift Nangong Qiuyue half of her body against the tree. When he reached out and touched Nangong Qiuyue, he stopped again and was too embarrassed to move.
After all, Nangong Qiuyue is a lady, well-informed, and has a much more generous attitude. She knew that Zhao Yu was embarrassed, so she said: "You have bandaged my body just now, are you embarrassed to help me? "
Zhao Yu was a little embarrassed, chuckled, then reached out to help Nangong Qiuyue up and half leaned against the tree, then picked up the pill and brought it to Nangong Qiuyue's mouth. Nangong Qiuyue held the pill in her mouth, took another sip of the water that Zhao Yu handed over, swallowed the pill, and started refining.
About an hour later, Nangong Qiuyue refined the pills, and immediately felt her body was much better. When she opened her eyes, she saw Zhao Yu standing in front of her, holding a short knife tightly in his hand, staring nervously at the surroundings, fearing something unexpected, and had been protecting him.
Nangong Qiuyue's heart suddenly trembled, an indescribable feeling surged through her body, and her eyes were moist.
After a pause, she whispered to Zhao Yu: "Zhao, Zhao Yu, I have refined the medicine you gave me. The elixir is really effective. I feel much better now. Thank you! "
"Zhao Yu"
These were the two words she shouted for the first time in her life.
Zhao Yu turned around and looked at Nangong Qiuyue after hearing the sound. Sure enough, he looked much better. He breathed a long sigh of relief and looked excited.
Nangong Qiuyue said to Zhao Yu again: "Look, my hands are still inconvenient, can you take a piece of my hair and tie it up? "
Zhao Yu saw that it was indeed the case. Nangong Qiuyue's hair was disheveled and she was in a very embarrassed state.
Although she still felt a little embarrassed, she still walked over, straightened Nangong Qiuyue's hair, and hurriedly tied it up, which was really useless.No style.
He saw the stains and blood on Nangong Qiuyue's face again, which was a bit scary. He took out a piece of cloth, dipped it in water, and wiped Nangong Qiuyue's face. After he wiped off the stains and blood on Nangong Qiuyue's face, Zhao Yu was shocked!
Although he had never seen a woman since his birth, he knew subconsciously that there were few in the world with such a beautiful face.
Nangong Qiuyue looked at Zhao Yu who was in a daze, and she was a little nervous herself. She asked in confusion, "What's wrong? I have flowers on my face, or am I disfigured?"
Hearing Nangong Qiuyue's voice, Zhao Yu came back from his daze. He felt uneasy and felt that he was too embarrassed and rude. He replied with a heated face and embarrassment: "Your face is not disfigured. It's very good. I saw that Miss Nangong is too beautiful, so..."
Zhao Yu lowered his head and didn't know what to say.
It seems that all women in the world like to be praised for their beauty, and Nangong Qiuyue is not exempt from this. Especially Zhao Yu's pure tone and true confession made her heart stirred up. She, who was originally elegant and generous, became coy and shy: "No way, I am just average in appearance. Does Mr. Zhao often praise other girls like this?"
"Ah!"
Zhao Yu exclaimed when he heard this, and said in a low and unnatural voice: "To be honest, apart from my mother, you are the first girl I have really met and talked to!
I only met my mother when she was a child, but I can’t remember what she looks like now. "
"How is that possible?"
This time it was Nangong Qiuyue's turn to be shocked and repeated: "How is this possible?"
He was stunned for a moment and then said: "What about your mother?"
Upon hearing Nangong Qiu's question, Zhao Yu felt as if someone had pressed the stop button. His voice and movement were completely silent, and he just stared blankly into the distance.
Nangong Qiuyue suddenly felt heartache, a very deep and heavy heartache. She already suspected in her heart that something extraordinary must have happened to Zhao Yu.
